description: Erection of a single storey rear and side extension and detached single storey outbuilding to the rear of the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ([Unnumbered Location Plan], [01], [02], [03], [04], [05], [06], [07], Received: 14/05/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used for the purpose as a play room/gym or for any other purpose incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 444 Great West Road, and not as a self-contained dwelling nor as a business premises, nor shall any kitchen, bathroom, toilet or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
